svg.title: Tech stack
svg.desc: Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, SQL. Backend: Node.js, Express, Bun, REST, WebSockets, SSE, OAuth 2.0. Data & queues: PostgreSQL, pgvector, Redis, BullMQ, MongoDB, Drizzle, Prisma, indexing, full-text search. Cloud & DevOps: AWS (EC2, S3), Docker, GitHub Actions, Linux, Git, Railway, Render, DigitalOcean, Vercel. Testing: Vitest, Supertest, Testing Library, integration + load tests. AI: Claude API, OpenAI API, RAG, embeddings, hybrid retrieval. Frontend: React, Next.js, Tailwind
